params.name: side
params.description: Allows platforms to specify the side of the quote

params.name: underlying
params.description: Allows platforms to specify the underlying asset

params.name: quoted_currency
params.description: Allows platforms to specify the quoted asset

params.name: quantity
params.description: The `quantity` of the `underlying` asset requested in the quote. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied.

params.name: total
params.description: The `total` of the `quoted_currency` asset requested in the quote. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: The participant requesting a quote to buy or sell an asset

params.name: account_label
params.description: The account_label that's used to fund the trade

params.name: spread
params.description: Optional custom spread in basis points applied to the quote. Requires the platform to be configured to pass spread through this endpoint.

params.name: commission
params.description: Optional custom commission in basis points applied to the quote. Mutually exclusive with `spread`; only available to platforms with `spread_as_commission` enabled.

params.name: quote_expiry
params.description: Optional quote expiration window. Feature-flag gated per platform.

items.docs: Retrieves a quote for the purchase or sale of a given asset. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be provided.
Retrieves a quote for the purchase or sale of a given asset. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied in the request body.
Updates an active quote's `total` (and optionally its `fees`) before execution. The `quote_id` and new `total` are both required.
Executes the quote identified by `quote_id`. Returns the executed quote, the booked `trade_id`(s), and the trade status.
